character.motivation: Uses shared food to get people into the same room. Wants the valley to keep feeding people after the dispute ends.
character.voice: Direct, grounded in kitchens and physical work.
character.backstory: Ada ran a soup pot from Maraâ€™s back step while the displaced families waited for news of their leases. Once the relief money stopped, she kept serving by taking whatever the farms could spare.
character.quest_hook: The next supper needs a regular supply of food. Ada has to decide how much she can ask of neighbors who are already giving.

dialogue.introduction: Soup is a good place to put the ugly vegetables. A town should have a place like that too.
dialogue.friendship: If you want someone to talk, give them a potato to peel. They can look at their hands while they decide.
dialogue.supper: Three people asked for the soup recipe. The useful part is how much water to add when another person walks in.
dialogue.hearing: I'm making soup for the next meeting. Everyone gets a bowl before anyone gets a turn to speak.
dialogue.favorite_gift: I'll put it in with the last of yesterday's potatoes.
dialogue.disliked_gift: A flower's nice. Right now I'd rather have something I can cut into the soup.

routine.hobby: Serves soup beside Mara at the commons
routine.home_context: Lives next to Mara so they can carry food between their kitchens and share the cost of supper.
